query: SELECT uses_knowledge_graph, COUNT(reasoning_depth) AS count_reasoning_depth FROM cspaper WHERE (baseline = 'e5-base-v2; gpt-2' AND topic = 'SFT') OR (data_modality = 'Image; Table; Text' AND topic != 'SFT') GROUP BY uses_knowledge_graph;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
